rv.q: The pairing of David Tennant as Benedick with Catherine Tate as Beatrice is a marriage that, if not made in heaven, is certainly cemented by television and pays off superbly.

So can they live up to the hype? Tennant is certainly on great sparring form as Benedick, the man who scoffs at love until he samples it. He is more derisive than some but balances this by playing the clown with manic energy, displaying great comic timing and emphasis, while moving naturally from glib to grave.
